meta.title: myDeutschFlow — Practise German job interviews with AI
meta.description: Practise German job interviews with AI: questions for your profession and feedback after every answer. A1–B1 learning path, mock exams in Goethe format.

hero.eyebrow: AI Interview Coach · For working and training in Germany
hero.sub: An AI plays the German employer, asks questions for your field and shows you what to fix after every answer: grammar, word choice, missing points.

stats.l: learning path on the CEFR scale

pains.title: Why a German interview is harder than you think

items.title: Warum wollen Sie bei uns arbeiten?
items.body: A simple question, yet many candidates give answers that fall short, because German interview culture is new to them.

items.title: Clear pronunciation when calm, gone under pressure
items.body: Practising alone, nobody corrects you. In the real interview, stress makes you mispronounce the very words you learnt.

items.title: No idea what German HR expects
items.body: Germans value preparation, precision and a direct attitude — very different from interviews in Vietnam.

items.title: No safe place to practise
items.body: You cannot afford mistakes with a real recruiter. Practising with friends lacks expert feedback and German context.

how.title: Three steps to a successful interview

items.title: Pick your trade and level
items.body: Enter your profession and German level. The AI picks interview questions for your trade and level, from A2 to B2.

items.title: Interview with a German AI recruiter
items.body: The AI plays a German interviewer, asks in German and adapts pace and complexity to you.

items.title: Get a detailed analysis
items.body: After every session: a score for each part of the interview, your answers quoted back, and concrete tips to improve.

features.title: Every tool you need to be ready for Germany
features.sub: One complete platform — from speaking practice and vocabulary to exam prep and progress tracking, all personalised to your trade.

items.name: AI speaking practice
items.desc: The AI plays a German employer, interviews you for your trade and points out grammar mistakes, wrong words and missing points after every sentence.

items.name: Video lessons
items.desc: In the mobile app: visuals, German voice-over and Vietnamese–German subtitles for vocabulary, grammar and listening.

items.name: SRS vocabulary
items.desc: Review cards at the right moment with spaced repetition — remember longer, forget less.

items.name: Personal learning path
items.desc: Lessons ordered by your level and goal, one clear road from A1 to B1.

items.name: Goethe exam practice
items.desc: Simulates all four parts (Lesen, Hören, Schreiben, Sprechen) in exam format, auto-scored. Speaking scoring is in beta.

items.name: Progress reports
items.desc: Track XP, study streaks, strong and weak skills and your full activity history.

path.shotCap: Real screen · A learner’s roadmap tree
path.shotAlt: A 30-day roadmap tree: the 12 finished stages have grown leaves, the stage in progress is a flower, and the panel on the right lists day 13’s four skills — listening, reading, speaking and writing.
path.title: From A1 to B1, one clear road
path.sub: Most learners going abroad for work need B1. We map out every step and adjust to your pace.
path.goal: Default goal: B1. You can change it any time in your profile.

levels.name: Getting started
levels.body: Greetings, introducing yourself, numbers, simple everyday sentences.

levels.name: Basic communication
levels.body: Daily work, shopping, appointments, talking about the past with Perfekt.

levels.name: Confident at work
levels.body: Interviews, the workplace, subordinate clauses with „weil", „dass".

levels.name: Professional fluency
levels.body: Writing at work, discussions, Passiv and complex sentence structures.

industries.title: Made for your trade
industries.sub: Pick a trade to see how the AI trains you — real questions in German and the key vocabulary.
industries.more: For other roles such as office and retail, the AI uses a general interview question set, adapts it to the position you enter and adds questions when needed.
industries.soonNote: A dedicated question set for this trade is being written. Until then the AI uses the general interview question set, adapted to the position you enter.

items.label: IT / Engineering
items.pitch: Technical interviews in German — you present projects, explain solutions and coordinate in an international team.

items.label: Kitchen / F&B
items.pitch: Interviews for cooks and kitchen assistants — hygiene, procedures and working fast under pressure.

items.label: Nursing
items.pitch: Germany's most understaffed sector. Interviews focus on care experience, medical ethics and handling situations with patients.

items.label: Construction
items.pitch: Interviews for builders and craftspeople — skills, occupational safety and reading technical drawings.

exam.title: Mock exams in the real exam format
exam.sub: Practise all four parts of the Goethe-Zertifikat B1/B2 under exam-like conditions, with a weakness analysis after every attempt.

parts.name: Reading
parts.body: 5 reading parts with everyday and workplace texts, auto-scored instantly.

parts.name: Listening
parts.body: Dialogues, announcements and radio interviews at real exam speed.

parts.name: Writing
parts.body: Emails and opinion pieces — submit a photo, the AI scores structure and grammar.

parts.name: Speaking
parts.body: Paired speaking, practised with the AI before exam day. Speaking scoring is in beta.

exam.disclaimer: Mock exams simulate the exam format and are not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut or telc. Speaking scoring is in beta; scores are for guidance only.

See strengths and weaknesses per class and per student to teach what matters.
